```python
def _fill_missing_statistics(model: nn.Module, statistics: Dict[str, Dict[
    str, int]]) ->Dict[str, Dict[str, int]]:
    """
    Fills in missing statistics for modules that are not present in the
    statistics dictionary. Any module that appears in the model but not in
    a particular statistic will be assigned a value of 0 for that statistic.
    
    Args:
        model (nn.Module): the model to extract module names from
        statistics (dict(str, dict(str, int))): statistics organized by
            statistic type, then by module name
    
    Returns:
        dict(str, dict(str, int)): the input statistics with missing
            modules filled in with 0 values
    """
    # Get all module names from the model
    all_module_names = set()
    all_module_names.add("")  # Add root module
    for name, _ in model.named_modules():
        if name:  # Skip empty string as we already added it
            all_module_names.add(name)
    
    # Fill in missing statistics
    filled_stats = {}
    for stat_name, stat_dict in statistics.items():
        filled_stats[stat_name] = {}
        for module_name in all_module_names:
            if module_name in stat_dict:
                filled_stats[stat_name][module_name] = stat_dict[module_name]
            else:
                filled_stats[stat_name][module_name] = 0
    
    return filled_stats
```
